about: 15 realistic questions on State Acts (rent control, stamp duty, money-lending, apartments) for the semantic-search test. A result is a hit when it belongs to an Act whose title starts with `act` in that `state` and its text contains `anchor` (a phrase from the statute); `section` is the section number it should be. All 15 anchors were checked against the section text in Neon. Duplicate filings of the same Act count as hits.

questions.question: Can a landlord in Maharashtra switch off water or electricity to a tenant?
questions.anchor: cut-off or withhold any essential supply or service enjoyed by the tenant

questions.question: Does a leave and licence agreement have to be registered in Maharashtra?
questions.anchor: any agreement for leave and licence or letting of any premises

questions.question: Can a tenant in Maharashtra sub-let the premises without the landlord's permission?
questions.anchor: it shall not be lawful for tenant to sub-let or give on licence

questions.question: How is the fair rent of a building fixed in Kerala?
questions.act: The Kerala Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act
questions.anchor: fix the fair rent for such building after holding such enquiry as it thinks fit

questions.question: Tenant in Kerala does not know the landlord's address. Can he deposit the rent?
questions.act: The Kerala Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act
questions.anchor: Where the address of the landlord or his authorised agent is not known to the tenant

questions.question: What must an officer do when an instrument that is not duly stamped comes before him in Karnataka?
questions.anchor: chargeable in his opinion, with duty

questions.question: Is a document without proper stamp duty accepted as evidence in Maharashtra?
questions.anchor: shall be admitted in evidence for any purpose by any person having by law or consent of parties authority to receive evidence

questions.question: What stamp duty applies to a leave and licence agreement in Maharashtra?
questions.anchor: Where the leave and licence agreement purports to be for a term not exceeding sixty months

questions.question: Must a rent agreement be in writing in Karnataka?
questions.anchor: except by an agreement in writing

questions.question: Who gets the tenancy when a tenant dies in Karnataka?
questions.anchor: In the event of death of a tenant, the right of tenancy shall devolve

questions.question: The landlord refuses to take rent in Karnataka. Can the tenant deposit it?
questions.anchor: Where the landlord does not accept any rent and other charges tendered by the tenant

questions.question: Can an unlicensed money lender in Maharashtra recover a loan through court?
questions.anchor: No court shall pass a decree in favour of a money-lender in any suit unless

questions.question: Who sets the maximum interest a money lender can charge in Maharashtra?
questions.anchor: fix the maximum rates of interest to be charged by a money-lender

questions.question: Can a landlord in Telangana cut off water or other amenities from a tenant?
questions.act: The Telangana Buildings (Lease, Rent and Eviction) Control Act
questions.anchor: No landlord shall, without just or sufficient cause, cut off or withhold any of the amenities enjoyed by the tenant

questions.question: How are common expenses of an apartment building shared among owners in Maharashtra?
questions.anchor: common profits of the property shall be distributed among, and the common expenses shall be charged to, the apartment owners
